scope: Official visual references for Kate Evans, Carmille Tewy and Girish Toprak; no fan art used and no new character art generated

kate-evans.role_scope: Queen Flight leader; name and role from official character pages
visible_identity: Dark nearly black hair, straight fringe, hair gathered in a low braided bun; side locks visible.
Official full render: black long-sleeved top, white shoulder/chest and forearm tape/bandage shapes, two dog tags, olive flight-suit upper half tied at waist, olive flight trousers, dark boots.
Official helmet: white shell, yellow lower side, black angular graphics and bee emblem; separate oxygen mask and visor.
Book page adds face/profile expressions, rear hair, rear rest outfit and equipped olive flight outfit.
kate-evans.stage_boundary: Distinguish off-duty/rest outfit from equipped flight outfit; no exact mission number inferred from the publicity render. Do not apply the white tape arrangement to every story stage automatically.
unresolved: Exact eye colour under neutral light
Hidden equipment side and precise insignia lettering at this scan resolution

carmille-tewy.role_scope: Lux Lunae commander in official character page; Moon 11 identity comes from separately recorded game HUD, not the character render filename
visible_identity: Official render: white peaked cap with gold emblem and trim, dark visor, black sunglasses, dark hair visible at temples.
White high-collar double-breasted uniform, gold cords/buttons/trim, red chest strap, white gloves, long lower coat panels, black boots and ornamented sheathed blade at waist/lap.
White enclosed-wheel mobility chair with large covered side wheels, small front wheels, arm supports and footplate.
Book page adds uncovered face/head designs, standing front/back costume design, headgear back cloth, white pressure-suit concept, chair and blade details.
carmille-tewy.stage_boundary: Seated commander appearance is directly supported by website render. Standing costume turnaround is design reference, not proof of walking ability in this stage. Pressure-suit concept is official-publication art; its exact mission association is not independently verified here.
unresolved: Rendered uncovered eye/face match beyond the book concept
Exact injury and mobility depiction per shot

girish-toprak.role_scope: Tewy subordinate / Sotoa ace per official character page; Shadow 22/Ares identity uses project separate gameplay/community evidence
visible_identity: Silver/grey-white swept-back short hair is explicit in book uncovered-head designs; the official cap shadow must not be misread as black hair.
Narrow dark moustache, pronounced sideburns, small dark patch below lower lip in the render; mature angular face.

Black peaked cap with pale metallic emblem and gold trim, black high-collared dress uniform and long cape, gold cords/trim, white shirt and dark tie, black gloves, decorated broad belt and curved sheathed blade.
Book page adds facial profiles, rear cape, costume and accessories; no full flight suit/helmet set collected here.
girish-toprak.stage_boundary: Official formal ground/command outfit, not automatically cockpit flight gear. Silver hair visible outside cap must remain consistent.
unresolved: Task-specific flight suit and oxygen mask
Hidden full cape fastening and gear side
